title: graphics.bitmap.decode result
description: One palette index per pixel, row-major. No colors and no RGBA: a palette is separate knowledge that may come from a Copper list, a config, or a guess, and combining it here would make one operation answer two questions.

indices.description: One palette index per pixel, row-major, hex-encoded. Hex rather than a JSON array because one byte per pixel as `[0,0,1,...]` costs several characters per pixel; the count is already bounded by `maximum_output_pixels`.

opaque.description: `bob` only: `01` where a pixel is opaque and `00` where it is not, in the same order as `indices`. Absent for shapes that have no transparency.
